name: Layered Codecs
description: The neutral LayeredImage (pixel layers with offset, opacity, blend mode, visibility, clipping and a placed mask, nested groups, the merged composite) and CodecError; the PixelCodec protocol apps plug their PNG codec into, with RawPixelCodec as the lossless test stand-in (a PNG signature and IHDR, then raw components); ZipStore, the stored-only zip container; the bounds-checked ByteReader and PackBits; the PSD reader (8-bit RGB and grayscale, raw and RLE channels, layer masks, blend modes, nested groups, the merged image, within maxSide, maxLayers and maxTotalPixels); the OpenRaster reader (StackXML, a small bounded stack.xml parser, with layer PNGs sized from their IHDRs within maxSide and a summed maxTotalPixels before any is decoded through the PixelCodec); the PSD writer (8-bit RGB, every channel RLE, groups as divider records, masks, Unicode names, blend keys and the merged image, validated before any byte is written so PSD read reopens it equal); the OpenRaster writer (stack.xml, one PNG per layer through the PixelCodec, mergedimage.png, a thumbnail 256 on its longest side and app extra entries, validated before anything is encoded so OpenRaster read reopens it equal).
